title: WP-SOL-A: freeze badf-solution-design composition contract (DESIGNED, thin router, no second gate)
objective: Build badf-solution-design as a top-level DECLARATIVE composition capability -- a thin router + constraint contract that composes the detailed specialist design contracts (UX/service, authorization, data, API, accessibility) into one coherent solution and emits G03/G04 evidence. It is NOT a sixth architecture skill, not a new gate, not a document-generation mega-skill: badf-architecture remains the structural spine and G04 coherence authority; badf-solution-design composes/routes/reconciles behavioral contracts against that spine. Freeze the contract only (WP-SOL-A): SKILL.md + eleven reference contracts, the SOL-I01..I12 cross-artifact invariants, the solution-composition matrix concept, the authorization-design framing, the API DESIGN/ASSURE split, and the FRAME->..->PACKAGE workflow. Register DESIGNED.
business_value: A collection of individually-valid specialist designs can compose into a broken solution (UX asserts an action authorization denies, an API with no data state behind it, a failure conveyed only by color). BADF has G03/G04 evidence contracts but nothing that reconciles the seams between them. badf-solution-design makes cross-artifact coherence a first-class, deterministic-where-fragile discipline -- the detailed-design equivalent of the G02 RTM -- without a second gate or new authority. Contract-freeze first keeps the admission ladder honest and defers specialist/validator work to separate WPs.
in_scope: skills/badf-solution-design/SKILL.md -- thin router (what/who-owns/inputs/output-contract/reconcile/uncertainty/which-gate); SOL-I01..I12; FRAME->INGEST->ROUTE->SPECIALIZE->COMPOSE->RECONCILE->CHALLENGE->TRACE->PACKAGE; status points to the registry, never hardcoded
